A spin echo needs a $\pi$ pulse:
\begin{equation}
e^{i\phi} = -1, \qquad \phi \equiv \pi \pmod{2\pi} .
\label{eq:pi1}
\end{equation}
and for the Rabi drive
\begin{equation}
\sin\frac{\Omega t}{2} = 1, \qquad \Omega t \equiv \pi .
\label{eq:pi2}
\end{equation}
For a $2\pi$ rotation the spinor changes sign,
\begin{equation}
\cos\frac{\theta}{2} = -1 \quad \text{and} \quad \theta \equiv 2\pi .
\label{eq:pi3}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
